title: Quadratic Functions and Equations | Algebra I, Unit 9
description:
Graph parabolas and find the vertex, use vertex form and transformations, then solve quadratic equations by graphing, square roots, factoring, completing the square and the quadratic formula. Use the discriminant to count solutions, and model with quadratics. Each section ends with a practice problem.
